column1: # Russian stress exceptions: context-free forms the lexicon tiers or the context student get wrong.
# word <TAB> stressed vowel (0-based, counting vowels in the word) <TAB> source
# A form is listed only when OpenRussian (CC BY-SA) and the Wiktionary extraction (kaikki.org, CC BY-SA)
# both give exactly one stress for it (both follow Zaliznyak's dictionary). True homographs
# (замок, все/всё, краю, плоти, живы, ...) are NOT listed: the sentence decides those.
# понять, поднять, принять: perfective past (feminine ends in the stressed -а; the lexicon lists a first-syllable variant too)
